notes: Fastned "Lucid Air 112 kWh (2023+)" curve, 2-95 %, European network, battery near 30 C, peak 305.6 kW at 2 % (1.9 % over the 300 kW rating). Pack 112 kWh matches these Grand Touring ids. InsideEVs 2024 GT test (Moloughney, EA 350 kW) peaked at 319 kW and held >200 kW above 40 %; Fastned holds 203 kW at 40 %, so the shape agrees. The 2025-27 Grand Touring ids list 117 kWh in the spec data and are not covered; the 118 kWh Dream/Sapphire have their own curve. Covered range 2-95 %; outside it the viewer holds the end values, so 0-2 % and 95-100 % are not measured. Fastned labels this entry "2023+", so the 2022 Grand Touring is an assumption (same 112 kWh pack, software unproven). Spec-data oddities: 2023-grand-touring-performance lists gross 112 / usable 109.1 and 2024-grand-touring lists gross 111 / usable 112, so the "112 kWh" pack match is approximate for those two ids.
